title: Critical-log payment of the finite-carrier mixed target row
analyticClaims: The mixed row is bounded by 6 sqrt(nu) d |Kz| times the square root of lambda0 E_A m_* Q_*.
The scalar reciprocal-weight envelope is comparable to (1+a)^(-1/3)/(1+log(2+a)).
The all-odd Rudin-Shapiro family has mixed row M^2, action M^(2/3) log M, and profile moment M^(7/3)/log M up to fixed constants.
finiteDiagnostics: The producer and independent routes use different gauges, sign generators, integrators, quadratures, and truncations.
The figure reports normalized finite values and exact-root residuals.
claimBoundary: The analytic result is confined to the finite-carrier triangular 2.5D row problem. Binary64 diagnostics corroborate finite cases. The figure does not prove a full physical critical-log estimate, a continuation criterion, blow-up, or general three-dimensional Navier-Stokes regularity.
